verdicts.reason: A is a faithful, uniform scale-down with the original's layout. Its headline is tight to the side edges (about 10px margins), and the nurse illustration seems to stop just short of the bottom edge instead of running off it cleanly. B has the same tight headline, but it lifts the nurse higher, so the illustration ends in a hard horizontal line with a visible purple strip below it and looks cut off and floating. The chevrons also crowd the nurse's cap in B.
